benchmark.primary: Median paired process-time ratio full_grid/local_factors >=2; support if at least2, otherwise not met. This is a fixed source implementation benchmark, not statistical generalization.
benchmark.warmup: One untimed equivalence pass for both methods over the fixed512 candidates; all loaded inputs promoted losslessly before timing.
benchmark.process_affinity: Pin micro and full-job benchmarks to the lowest allowed logical CPU; record allowed/pinned CPUs and environment.

full_job_benchmark.decision: Only if both finish, compare all scientific audit fields excluding elapsed time and floating-point error maxima; then report measured process/wall ratios. If either times out, report timeout and any conservative bound, never a measured completed ratio.

full_verification.all_candidates: Every H2ay trace candidate, no subsampling; unchanged graph/native margin/final energy/flags/readout checks
full_verification.persistence: Atomic per-job rows; collect as completed; retain all partial rows on failure. Write successor audit only under local_factor_audit, never original density_transfer/audit.json.

scientific_accounting.original_H2ay_audit_budget_status: Failed300s limit remains failed; later complete verification uses separately declared600s budget. No original budget extension or inference rerun.
